description: Expected shape of contract state immediately after applying an upgrade against tests/fixtures/upgrade/pre_upgrade_state.json. Field counts and totals must match; new optional fields introduced by the upgrade may be added but existing fields must not be removed or retyped.
invariants: config.admins length and admin_threshold are byte-for-byte identical to pre-upgrade
each loan's status enum value maps to the same semantic status post-upgrade (active/repaid/defaulted)
credit_scores entries exist for every account present pre-upgrade, with scores unchanged unless the upgrade explicitly recalculates scoring (must be documented in the upgrade PR if so)
treasury.fee_treasury and treasury.slash_treasury are unchanged unless the upgrade explicitly modifies treasury accounting (must be documented in the upgrade PR if so)

post_upgrade_checks.expect: matches config block above, plus any new fields with documented defaults
score=620 unless upgrade PR documents a recalculation
15000000 unless upgrade PR documents a treasury migration
